label: Gaze
description: Eye direction and eye contact independently of expression and body posture.
notes: Direction of attention visible in the eyes, plus minimal head orientation needed to establish it. Expression owns eyelid tension and emotion; pose owns body and limb arrangements. Excludes named targets, props, places, and other people.

values.text: gazing straight ahead past the camera
looking down and to one side
looking up and to one side
looking sideways while keeping the head facing forward
looking toward the camera with the head turned to one side
gazing into the distance with the face in profile
gazing downward with the face in profile
